title: Epistemology of Tacit Knowing and Scientific Commitment

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Michael Polányi (Polányi Mihály) challenged the positivist view that science is purely impersonal and algorithmic. His best-known idea, that we know more than we can tell, highlights the central role of *hallgatólagos tudás* (tacit knowledge); this is a paraphrase, not a quotation.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: When discussing epistemology, abstract verbal compounds and nominal predicates describe cognitive processes: *A tudományos megismerés nem pusztán szabálykövetés, hanem a személyes elköteleződés és a mesterségbeli tudás egysége.*

sections.title: Patterns in Context
